raw_segments.text: In other parts stood one who, at the forge laboring, two massy clods of iron and brass
had melted, whether found where casual fire had wasted woods on mountain or in vale,
down to the veins of earth, thence gliding hot to some cave's mouth, or whether washed
by stream from underground, the liquid ore he drained into fit molds prepared, from which
he formed first his own tools, then what might else be wrought fusil or graven in metal.
After these, but on the hither side, a different sort from the high neighboring hills, which
was their seat, down to the plain descended. By their guise just men they seemed, and all
their study bent to worship God aright, and know his works not hid. Nor those things last,
which might preserve freedom and peace to men. They on the plain long had not walked,
